title: Programme of the day
description: The moments of the day in order, who performs them and what guests see. Times are those of the event day.
undated: The occasion has no date yet. Times stay as you write them and settle on the day once you choose it.
revision: Changes guests have seen so far: {count}
notifyNote: When you change a guest-visible moment, the guests it concerns get one email — not one per touch-up. Those who left no address see the change marked on their link.

remove.title: Delete “{title}”?
remove.body: The moment leaves the programme together with its cues. If guests could see it, those it concerned are told once.

fields.title: Moment
fields.nextDayHint: Tick for moments in the night of the event, such as the cake at 00:30.
fields.performerHint: A supplier's moments can be sent into their briefing.
fields.visibleHint: Shown on the guests' link and, if you choose, on the public page.
fields.householdsEmpty: There are no guests on the list yet.

empty.title: The programme is still empty
empty.body: Add the first moment — for example “Ceremony, 16:00”. Then give it cues and show it to guests.
empty.bodyReadOnly: The organisers have not added any moment yet.

cues.title: Cues — {title}
cues.intro: The cue list says who does what and when, counted from the start of the moment. Every save keeps the version before it.
cues.unchanged: Nothing to save — the list is the same as version {version}.
cues.empty: There are no cues yet. Add the first.

briefing.sectionIntro: Send each performer their moments and cues. They arrive as a new version of the briefing, which the performer confirms on their link.
briefing.include: Include the programme in the briefing
briefing.included: Published as version {version} of the briefing.

guest.title: Programme
guest.intro: The moments you are expected at.
guest.changedNotice: The programme has changed. The changed moments are marked below.

email.subject: The programme has changed: {occasion}
email.body: The organisers changed something in the programme of “{occasion}” that concerns you.
email.where: Open your invitation link to see the current times and places.
email.why: You get this message once for this change, because you left your address when you answered the invitation.

export.title: Programme of the day (CSV)
export.description: Every moment with its time, place, performer and current cues.

errors.duration: Write the length in minutes, between 1 and 1440.
errors.chooseHouseholds: Choose at least one household or switch to “all guests”.
errors.tooMany: The programme has reached the maximum number of moments.
errors.cueOffset: Write the minute as a number, for example 0 or 5.
errors.cueInstruction: Write what happens at this cue or remove the row.
errors.tooManyCues: A list can hold at most 60 cues.
errors.noPerformerItems: This supplier has no moment in the programme yet.
errors.briefingUpToDate: The briefing already has the current programme.
